title: NFL says field in Brazil is good to go for Ravens-Cowboys on Sunday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFL says field in Brazil is good to go for Ravens-Cowboys on Sunday
sources.description: Amid talk that the field at Maracanã Stadium in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, is not going to hold up to the rigors of an NFL game, the league is insisting all is fine.
